title: 8 Network Security Policy Management Tools: Our Top Picks by Use Case (2026)
content_md: The verdict: FireMon is the strongest pick when your problem is detecting unauthorized change and cleaning up rule bloat, Tufin when your estate is genuinely multi-vendor and sprawling, and AlgoSec when application owners are queueing up change requests. RedSeal and Forward Networks answer a different question entirely proving what your network actually permits. And one vendor on the list we were asked to review no longer exists, which matters a great deal if it’s on your shortlist. Network security policy management tools discover, analyse, automate, and audit firewall and security policy across multi-vendor estates according to a comprehensive network security checklist turning thousands of accumulated rules into something you can reason about, change safely, and prove to an auditor. Read This Before You Shortlist Skybox Security ceased operations in February 2025. Its technology assets were acquired by Tufin, and existing customers did not receive a support transfer. Skybox appears on the vendor list we were asked to evaluate and continues to appear as an active recommendation in a surprising number of published comparison articles. It is not a purchase option. If you are running Skybox today, treat this as an active migration project: export your policy model, rule risk data, and compliance history while the environment is still functional, assume no vendor support, and evaluate FireMon, Tufin, and AlgoSec as replacements.
